name: Shader Upscale for Vestra Player
author: zysilm
punchline: Real-time GPU upscaling with mpv GLSL shaders: Anime4K for anime; AMD FSR 1, RAVU and FSRCNNX for live action
description: Sharpens and enlarges the video on the GPU while it plays, with mpv shaders bundled in the plugin: Anime4K for anime (six modes, Fast, HQ or Ultra), AMD FSR 1 for everything else, and RAVU (light) or FSRCNNX (high) for live action, plus three add-ons: chroma upscaling (CfL), SSIM downscaling for videos larger than the window, and adaptive sharpening. Video ▸ Shader Upscaling… opens a window to choose them, turn upscaling on and off, and see what is applied. Needs GPU rendering: macOS, or Windows with Video ▸ GPU Rendering (Experimental). Remembers your choice.
